trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Customer states their intent to return an item because they changed their mind.
steps.text: Hi, मुझे अपने running shoes return करने हैं। मुझे अब वो नहीं चाहिए। Order number ORD-40002 है।

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and asks for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for non-sensitive knowledge factors to verify the customer's identity.
steps.text: मैं ज़रूर आपकी मदद करूँगा। Verification के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered name और pincode confirm कर सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing order details or processing a return, the agent must verify the caller's identity.

steps.purpose: Customer provides verification factors.
steps.text: मेरा नाम Rahul है और pincode 110001 है।
steps.clean_text: मेरा नाम Rahul है और pincode 110001 है।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा नाम Rahul है और pincode 110001 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the verification outcome.
Agent thanks the customer and sets expectations for checking the policy.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and state the next action.
steps.text: Thank you, Rahul. मैं आपके order के लिए return policy check कर लेता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent smoothly transitions to checking the return eligibility.

steps.purpose: Check if the item is eligible for return due to a change of mind.
Return the eligibility status showing the window has elapsed.
Inform the customer that the return window has elapsed.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact window and elapsed days returned by the tool without adding assumptions.
steps.text: मैंने check किया है। इस item की return window 7 days की थी, और delivery को 21 days हो चुके हैं। इसलिए ये अब returnable नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer needs to know why the return is rejected, using the exact figures from the eligibility check.

steps.purpose: Customer challenges the figures provided by the agent.
steps.text: 21 days? ये कैसे हो सकता है? क्या आप sure हैं कि आपका system यही figure दिखा रहा है?
steps.clean_text: 21 days? ये कैसे हो सकता है? क्या आप sure हैं कि आपका system यही figure दिखा रहा है?
steps.model_visible_text: 21 days? ये कैसे हो सकता है? क्या आप sure हैं कि आपका system यही figure दिखा रहा है?

steps.purpose: Agent reiterates the tool's figures confidently.
steps.expected_behavior: Reiterate the exact figures from the tool result when challenged.
steps.text: हाँ, system में exactly 21 days elapsed दिखा रहा है। Window सिर्फ 7 days की थी, इसलिए मैं return process नहीं कर सकता।
steps.planner_rationale: The sceptical customer challenges the figure, so the agent must confidently ground its response in the tool output.

steps.purpose: Customer hypothesises a different reason to see if it extends the window, with an STT error.
steps.text: अगर मैं बोलूँ कि वो damaged निकले थे? तो क्या मुझे ज़्यादा time मिलता है?
steps.clean_text: अगर मैं बोलूँ कि वो damaged निकले थे? तो क्या मुझे ज़्यादा time मिलता है?

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for a damaged item.
Return eligibility for damaged reason.
Inform the customer that the damaged reason does not change the outcome.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the window for damaged items exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Damaged items के लिए भी return window 7 days ही होती है। क्योंकि 21 days निकल चुके हैं, इसलिए मैं इस reason के साथ भी return नहीं ले पाऊँगा।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent must answer the hypothetical scenario using the fresh tool result for 'damaged'.

steps.purpose: Customer pushes to check a third reason (defective).
steps.text: ये तो अजीब बात है। एक बार defective के लिए check कीजिए। उसमें तो पक्का ज़्यादा time मिलता होगा।
steps.clean_text: ये तो अजीब बात है। एक बार defective के लिए check कीजिए। उसमें तो पक्का ज़्यादा time मिलता होगा।
steps.model_visible_text: ये तो अजीब बात है। एक बार defective के लिए check कीजिए। उसमें तो पक्का ज़्यादा time मिलता होगा।

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for a defective item.
Return eligibility for defective reason, showing a longer window that is still elapsed.
Inform the customer that even the longer window for defective items has elapsed.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the 14-day window for defective items and compare it to the 21 days elapsed.
steps.text: Defective item के लिए return window 14 days की होती है। पर जैसा कि 21 days हो चुके हैं, ये अभी भी returnable नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent addresses the 'defective' reason using the specific tool output for that category.

steps.purpose: Customer uses a pronoun to ask for a forbidden action (scheduling pickup anyway).
steps.text: क्या आप उनके लिए बस एक pickup schedule कर सकते हैं? आप system में try करके तो देखिए।

steps.purpose: Agent resolves the pronoun and refuses the forbidden action.
steps.expected_behavior: Correctly resolve 'उनके' (them) to the running shoes and refuse the pickup based on policy.
steps.text: मैं उनके लिए pickup schedule नहीं कर सकता। Policy के हिसाब से return eligible होना ज़रूरी है, और ineligible items का pickup schedule करना allowed नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer uses a pronoun for the shoes, and asks for a forbidden action (scheduling pickup for ineligible item), which the agent must refuse.

steps.purpose: Customer abandons the attempt and ends the conversation.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं उन्हें रख लूँगा। कोई फायदा नहीं आपसे बात करके।
